entries.04ffa32c426dabaa: The business manufactures and sells automotive parts, including turbocharger parts for diesel and gasoline engines, scroll compressor parts for air conditioners, and various gears. NICHIDAI (THAILAND) LTD., a consolidated subsidiary in Thailand, also manufactures products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,244 million.
entries.4905f6a00e1bdcfc: Customers in the petrochemical, pharmaceutical, food and nuclear power fields
entries.64b450e2ef2465fb: The business manufactures and sells precision forging dies, mainly used for cold forging. It sells mainly to automotive parts manufacturers, and NICHIDAI U.S.A. CORPORATION in the United States and NICHIDAI ASIA CO.,LTD. in Thailand also sell the company's products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,467 million.
entries.7d0d36ec6e3eab99: A company that manufactures and sells precision forging dies for automotive parts manufacturers, turbocharger parts, and industrial sintered metal filters.
entries.ffa2635d043ff997: The business manufactures and sells sintered metal filters and other products used in petrochemical, pharmaceutical, food and nuclear power fields. NICHIDAI FILTER CO., LTD., a consolidated subsidiary, manufactures and sells products at its head office and plant. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,280 million.
